# Float Pane: the focused pane becomes a live card in a corner of its
# split (in-window picture in picture); the pane itself is parked, its
# program running. Bringing it back puts it where it stood.
type:echo BASE-PANE
key:enter
wait:0.5
key:cmd+d
wait:1.0
type:echo FLOATER; sleep 2; echo FLOAT-STILL-RUNNING
key:enter
wait:0.5
expect-float:no
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.4
type:float pane
wait:0.3
expect-palette:Float Pane
key:enter
wait:1.0
expect-float:yes
expect-tab:1 parked
expect-not:2 panes
wait:2.5
expect:FLOAT-STILL-RUNNING
shot:float.png
# The same command brings it back.
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.4
type:float pane
wait:0.3
key:enter
wait:1.0
expect-float:no
expect-tab:2 panes
expect-not:parked
type:echo BACK-FROM-FLOAT
key:enter
wait:0.6
expect:BACK-FROM-FLOAT
